dedupe_keys.name: structural resilience of international digital connectivity under submarine cable disruption nato members and russia

description: Huseyin Saltan publishes a replication package for comparing international digital-connectivity resilience across 32 NATO member countries and Russia. It combines active submarine cable systems with operational cross-border terrestrial fibre links. R scripts and processed data evaluate retained direct external partners under random cable failures, geographically correlated disruption, complete submarine-cable outage and terrestrial concentration tests. Zenodo lists a ZIP archive containing data, code, tables, QGIS outputs, a codebook and reproducibility documentation, free under CC BY 4.0. The release dates from September 2026; the metadata do not specify one uniform topology observation date. The package supports structural network-disruption simulations. Its partner-retention measure excludes traffic volumes, bandwidth, latency, economic loss, repair time and dynamic rerouting, so those effects must not be inferred from its results. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified by the deposit.
